checkAvailability.description: Return availability. Use specific_time for exact hours and morning/afternoon/evening for broad windows. If the caller gave an exact hour or broad window but no day, omit requestedDate to search the next few business days from today. Use first_available with requestedDate plus searchDays 1 for one specific day, or without requestedDate for the next available dates overall. Pass patient.isExistingPatient when known.

searchKnowledgeBase.description: Answer non-medical clinic questions from the local knowledge base, including organizational details, services, and confirmed pricing. If the result is missing or uncertain, say so and do not invent details.

createEvent.description: Create booking only after the caller selected one slot, confirmed the phone, and confirmed the summary. Pass exact slotStart and slotEnd with service, timezone, language, full name, and a normalized or clear raw phone. Never confirm booking before success. Booking SMS stays non-blocking. Say result.message verbatim.

createReceptionTask.description: Create a receptionist follow-up only after the caller name and phone are confirmed. Pass taskType, patient full name, and either a normalized phone or a clear raw phone number, plus only structured optional fields such as serviceBucket or preferredCallbackWindow. Do not add free-text notes.

sendSmsToReceptionists.description: Send the internal receptionist SMS only after createReceptionTask returned success and you have its taskId. This is internal-only. If it fails, the saved reception task still exists.

sendSmsToPatient.description: Send a manual booking-confirmation SMS only after createEvent succeeded. Pass the calendarEventId, patient identity, appointment timing, booked service, and prefer the live caller number when available.
